competitions.label: UEFA Women's Champions League
competitions.notes: Europe's premier women's club competition. Run as the UEFA Women's Cup from 2001-02, rebranded the UEFA Women's Champions League in 2009.

competitions.label: FIFA Women's Champions Cup
competitions.notes: FIFA's new global women's club competition, contested for the first time in 2026.

competitions.label: Women's Super League (England)
competitions.notes: England's top flight. The FA Women's Premier League National Division from 1991-92, replaced by the Women's Super League in 2011.

competitions.label: Women's FA Cup (England)
competitions.notes: England's primary women's knockout cup, first contested in 1970-71.

competitions.label: Liga F / Primera División (Spain)
competitions.notes: Spain's top flight. The Primera División (Superliga) from 2001-02, rebranded the professional Liga F in 2022-23.

competitions.label: NWSL Championship (United States)
competitions.notes: The end-of-season playoff final of the National Women's Soccer League, the United States top flight, since 2013.

competitions.label: NWSL Shield (United States)
competitions.notes: Awarded to the NWSL regular-season points leader, distinct from the playoff Championship.
